longTitle.officialTitle: To authorize the Secretary of the Interior to acquire approximately 44 acres of land in Martinez, California, for inclusion in the John Muir National Historic Site, and for other purposes.

main.enactingFormula: Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the United States of America in Congress assembled,

section.heading: SHORT TITLE.
section.content: This Act may be cited as the “John Muir National Historic Site Expansion Act”.

paragraph.heading: Historic site.—
paragraph.content: The term “Historic Site” means the John Muir National Historic Site in Martinez, California, established by Public Law 88-547 (78 Stat. 753).

paragraph.heading: Map.—
paragraph.content: The term “map” means the map entitled “John Muir National Historic Site Proposed Boundary Expansion”, numbered 426/127150, and dated November 2014.

paragraph.heading: Secretary.—
paragraph.content: The term “Secretary” means the Secretary of the Interior.

section.heading: JOHN MUIR NATIONAL HISTORIC SITE LAND ACQUISITION.

subsection.heading: Acquisition.—
subsection.content: The Secretary may acquire by donation the approximately 44 acres of land and any interests in the land that is identified on the map.

subsection.heading: Boundary.—
subsection.content: On the acquisition of the land authorized under subsection (a), the Secretary shall adjust the boundaries of the Historic Site to include the acquired land.

subsection.heading: Administration.—
subsection.content: The land and any interests in land acquired under subsection (a) shall be administered as part of the National Historic Site.
